fields.label: From Qty
fields.description: Inclusive lower bound of this tier (in whatever unit the driver's Measurement Basis uses - sheets, pieces, cm²).

fields.label: To Qty
fields.description: Inclusive upper bound of this tier. Use a large number (e.g. 999999) for the top-open tier.

fields.label: Rate
fields.description: Rate that applies within this tier, in the driver's Measurement Basis unit (e.g. SAR per 1000 sheets).
